name: elate
description: Self-hosted marketplace for the elate plugin: sandboxed Emacs driving for AI harnesses (Agent Skill + MCP server).

plugins.name: elate
plugins.description: Spawn sandboxed Emacs sessions (terminal or GUI) and drive them with keys, mouse, and elisp to interactively test Emacs packages. Ships the elate Agent Skill (act -> wait -> observe workflow, ERT runs, lint, profiling, scenario scripts) plus the elate MCP server with typed tools, both backed by the elate CLI via uvx.
